scope: Keyboard reachability, activation, naming and visible focus for saved/live figure-grid tiles

retained_failures: The first traversal assertion stopped at a sibling button before finishing Qt creation-order focus traversal.
The stylesheet-only focus border did not paint; actual pixel validation rejected it.

repairs: Figure cells take StrongFocus, allowing normal Tab traversal.
Unmodified Return, numeric Enter and Space emit the existing clicked signal only when the tile owns focus.
Saved figures retain their original sparse queue indices; live and pinned panels retain their existing key routing.
QAccessible names reuse the existing caption, panel letter or live key, with numeric index fallback.
The focused tile paints a two-pixel palette Highlight border, ending its QPainter in finally. Mouse handlers and tile geometry are unchanged.
test_harness_notes: Initial setup-abort.log is preserved. The first fixture returned children without retaining their top-level host; changing it to yield retains the host for the test. Initial layout is settled and null focus now produces an assertion rather than a QTest abort.
The final Tab case checks one complete focus cycle rather than assuming Qt creation order equals visual layout order; it still requires every saved/live tile and a reachable exit button.
api_reason: The normal public_docstrings collector excludes the private _FigureCell class, including its new event overrides.
limits: QAccessible metadata and offscreen rendering are verified; this is not external-reader speech or native Windows/macOS acceptance.
No general shortcut-map, tutorial or whole-application keyboard audit is claimed.
